scope: Exact source/receipt archive and native boards. Frozen generic reporter wording is inherited; current conditional/neural modes are phase-kernel reconstruction above fixed global analytic/neural backgrounds. Raw H1 uses its own original scores. Prior unguided/current guided phase129 share all geometry, background, competing fit, phase kernel and support rules; only own-color neural range compatibility weights change.
status: complete; much higher constructed weak response with noise/error and real-artifact costs
quality_decision: Analytic nuisance plus A-only neural-guided phase:400/far weak28.702%, quiet+0.541% and increment-0.946% vs parent, both sources improve increment error. Versus unguided analytic, quiet/increment lower with retained response and building maximum531.58 to130.59 DN16. Guided NN nuisance primary has quiet+1.744%, increment+3.006%, both sources worse increment; not preferred. Neural building75.18 to55.20. Fine cab crossings remain absent; higher-noise errors remain. Useful measured analytic phase option, no broad/general-model promotion.
scope_clarification: Both phase arms use matching own-color A-only neural range guides; separate CFA amplitudes, same global background/competing fit/phase geometry/support and identical RAW-parent operator. Raw H1 controls remain byte-exact on all288 outputs. Analytic label refers to nuisance basis, not neural-free inference. Physical square-root coordinate has an approximate delta-method noise-unit interpretation, not calibrated neural uncertainty. Oblique-projection diagnostic rejects large global amplification on checked inputs. No neural replay or learned update.
